name: Nakuru Speedcubing Camp 2025
information: We are excited to introduce Kenya’s very first speedcubing camp! This will be a series of fun and helpful events where you can learn how to solve the cube faster and improve your skills. We will be gathering every holiday to practice, compete, and enjoy together. Everyone is welcome whether you are a beginner or an experienced cuber. Come join us and be part of this exciting new journey! We look forward to seeing you there..!
